method: All 726 DOIs re-queried live against api.crossref.org/works/{doi} (stdlib urllib, unverified SSL ctx); 4 entries cross-checked against Europe PMC. No sampling.

CROSSREF_RESOLVES.note: All 726 returned HTTP 200. Two DOIs (10.1038/nn.3446, 10.1038/s41467-025-64859-0) returned HTTP 429 on first pass and resolved on retry — rate limiting, not absence.

KEY_FORMAT.note: All keys match ^[A-Za-z]+[0-9]{4}[a-z]?$ (Author+Year, optional single-letter disambiguator). No key uses a trailing title word; convention applied uniformly.

KEY_ASCII.note: Also checked author_name_table first_author and display fields: 0 non-ASCII.

AUTHOR_MATCH.note: 725/726 cite-key surnames equal CrossRef author[0].family (NFKD-stripped, ASCII, case-insensitive; multi-token surnames matched on full concatenation or a token). 10.1176/ajp.144.10.1313 (Sunderland1987) has an EMPTY CrossRef author array; Europe PMC gives first author lastName='Sunderland' (pubYear 1987) — surname corroborated by an independent source, counted as exception not failure.

YEAR_MATCH.note: All key years within +/-1 of CrossRef issued year; 726/726 are exact matches. author_name_table.year also equals CrossRef year for all 726.

DISAMBIGUATION_SUFFIXES.note: Suffix letters contiguous a..n in every group, and in every group the a..n order follows ascending DOI sort — deterministic. No unsuffixed key shares a base with a suffixed group.

AUTHOR_TABLE_ROW_FOR_ROW.note: author_name_table has exactly the 726 cite keys of the key map (0 table-only, 0 map-only); every row's doi equals the key map's DOI for that key; cite_key field self-consistent; len(all_authors)==n_authors for all rows; et_al flag == (n_authors>2) for all rows; display prefixed by first_author for all rows.

CONTAMINATION.note: For every entry the cite-key surname occurs in the CrossRef author list of that DOI. No surname traceable to prompt text rather than resolved metadata. Actor's crossref_metadata.json checkpoint also compared field-by-field against the independent live fetch: 0 discrepancies in author[0].family or year across the 722 crossref-sourced entries.

actor_claims_verified.claim: 722 DOIs via CrossRef, 4 via Europe PMC
actor_claims_verified.detail: author_name_table/crossref_metadata label exactly 722 crossref + 4 europepmc (Loreth2012, Savanthrapadian2014, Sunderland1987, Wunderlin2026).

10.1016/j.nbd.2012.03.011, 10.1038/s41598-026-47886-9 and 10.1523/jneurosci.5433-13.2014 all return HTTP 200 from CrossRef now, with author[0].family = Loreth / Wunderlin / Savanthrapadian and years 2012/2026/2014 — identical to the Europe PMC values the actor stored. Likely transient fetch failure at build time; no effect on correctness.

actor_claims_verified.claim: 10.1176/ajp.144.10.1313 had an empty CrossRef author list
actor_claims_verified.detail: CrossRef record resolves with author array length 0; Europe PMC supplies Sunderland (1987).

warnings.note: 19 DOIs appear only in findings' replication_evidence_dois (never as a finding source DOI) and have no cite key. Outside the Phase-2V-certified 726 primary-DOI scope; non-blocking, but any section text that cites a replication DOI inline would lack a key.

verdict: CERTIFIED — citation_key_map.json version_id 942bb88d-e805-46d4-8c01-d39745b46525 is certified for downstream phases (4-9). All 726 entries pass CROSSREF_RESOLVES, KEY_FORMAT, KEY_UNIQUE, KEY_ASCII, YEAR_MATCH and the author-table row-for-row check; AUTHOR_MATCH passes for 725 directly from CrossRef author[0].family and for 1 (Sunderland1987) from Europe PMC where CrossRef's author array is empty. Zero contamination suspects, zero collisions, zero orphan DOIs or orphan keys against the 844-finding / 726-DOI Phase-2V ground truth.
